locking.refresh: SELECT user_devices ... FOR UPDATE by current/previous/consumed refresh hash
locking.logout: FOR UPDATE user_devices then auth_sessions (same order as refresh)
locking.otp_mfa: SELECT otp_requests / mfa_challenges WHERE id = ? FOR UPDATE

dual_refresh_same_token.invariant: At most one live session/device/refresh hash; reuse of the loser revokes the family; unique consumption hashes.

refresh_vs_logout.invariant: Device then session row locks. Logout commit leaves zero live sessions; refresh-first leaves at most one successor until logout revokes it.

rotated_reuse_vs_inflight_successor.invariant: Presenting N-1 while N is in flight revokes the family. Zero live sessions remain.

otp_single_consumer_and_attempts.invariant: FOR UPDATE on otp_requests: one consume, one session; concurrent wrong codes commit both attempt increments.

recovery_otp_single_consumer.invariant: Recovery complete locks the OTP row; one applied recovery and one credential_version bump.
